snippet.title: Pay Your Deeds - Official Release Trailer
snippet.description:
Pay Your Deeds is a roguelike deck-builder played on a 5×4 slot reel.

You are in debt, and every few days the Sector expects another payment.

Collect Symbols, build synergies, earn Scrap Credits and pay your Deeds before the Sector catches up with you.

Featuring 117 Symbols, multiple build archetypes, Campaign, Endless and UNKNOWN modes.

Discord : https://discord.com/invite/bPS8Nx5F7P

Available now on itch.io:
https://fatheronstream.itch.io/pay-your-deeds

Soon on Steam!
